اقتضبتم (form VIII)
# اِقْتَضَبْتُمْ (iqtaḍabtum) /iq.ta.dˤab.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
# اُقْتُضِبْتُمْ (uqtuḍibtum) /uq.tu.dˤib.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
